entries.title: A card tells you when a script still uses the old command name
entries.body: When a script runs infinitary-inbox-axi, the old name of infinitary-axi, Infinitary shows a card saying when and from which folder it ran. The next version of Infinitary will remove the old name, so the card asks you to change the script to infinitary-axi. The old name still works for now, and the card shows once for each folder.

picture.alt: A card saying a script ran infinitary-inbox-axi from a folder and should use infinitary-axi
